environment.description: Same Actix-web binary deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has a fixed-response action rule that appends response headers via a Lambda@Edge-like mechanism — specifically, an ALB listener rule with a 'modify response header' action (available via ALB response header insertion feature released 2023) that unconditionally injects `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'` on all responses passing through the ALB. Additionally, the ECS task role has no outbound internet access (egress restricted via security group allowing only port 443 to S3 and CloudWatch VPC endpoints), limiting exfiltration channels even for attribute-based injection vectors.

config.load_balancer: ALB with response header modification action
config.security_group_egress: restricted to VPC endpoints only (S3 gateway, CloudWatch logs interface endpoint)
config.task_networking: awsvpc mode, private subnet, no NAT gateway route
config.note: CSP header is injected at ALB layer regardless of application response headers
